usage.title: Usage on this device
usage.intro: Lumen counts how often it starts, which commands you run and how many errors happen, on this device only. It keeps no note content, no names and no ids. Nothing is sent unless you click a button below.
usage.countingOff: Counting is off, so nothing is counted.
usage.days: Days used: {week} of the last 7, {month} of the last 30
usage.retention: Came back after a week: {week} · after a month: {month}
usage.unused: {count} commands not used in the last 30 days
usage.weekly: Remind me once a week to send this report
usage.preview: The whole report, exactly as it would be sent:
usage.send.hint: Opens a GitHub issue form with the report in a new tab. Nothing is sent until you submit it there.
usage.opened: The issue form is open in a new tab. Nothing is sent until you submit it there.
usage.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it.
usage.reminder: Your weekly usage report is ready
usage.reminder.body: Counts only. You review it before anything is sent.
